lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 4 distinct vertical line segments observed on the lateral torso; central pair exhibits moderate spacing (~15% of torso width), while anterior and posterior lines are more distal and lower in contrast.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line segment is truncated mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral margin. The anterior-most segment is faint and terminates above the shoulder joint.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, centered above the knee joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the upper hind limb align in a distinct diagonal geometric line oriented toward the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible horn follows a lyrate trajectory, curving outward and backward from the frontal bone before tapering medially and anteriorly at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tip accounts for approximately 12% of the total visible vertical length of the primary horn.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white dorsal mane extending from neck to rump; three distinct white spots on the lower mandible/cheek; high-contrast white 'socks' on the distal portion of all four limbs.
